discovery.test_command: npm run test:core && npm run test:state && npm run test:ui

loops.verdict_explanation: Test suite is red across all three Jest workspaces at baseline: packages/core (7 tests fail), packages/state (2 suites fail to compile under RTK 2.x type tightening), packages/ui (Jest cannot parse @react-spectrum/s2 ESM module). Structural review is blocked until baseline tests are green.

findings.title: Build failure blocks structural review
findings.why_it_matters: Without a green baseline test/typecheck, every other architectural claim is unverifiable and the contest review cannot proceed.
findings.what_is_wrong: Three independent failure clusters: packages/core has 7 failing tests across analytics, modelResolver, and sorting; packages/state has 2 suites that fail to compile (store.ts TS errors + stale headToHeadSlice test field reference); packages/ui has 1 suite that fails to parse @react-spectrum/s2 ESM under Jest's default CJS transform.
findings.leverage_impact: Until baseline tests are green, no architectural change can be verified safe.
findings.locality_impact: Failures span three packages but each cluster is locally diagnosable.
findings.metric_signal: Test Suites: 3 failed/8 passed (core), 2 failed/2 passed (state), 1 failed/1 passed (ui)
findings.why_weakens_submission: Untrusted test suite blocks every contest claim about regression resistance, refactor safety, and architectural credibility.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Diagnose and fix; targeted scope only. Loop 1 fixes packages/state/src/store.ts to restore TypeScript compile (smallest cluster that re-enables RTK-level structural review of the largest mutable runtime concern). Subsequent loops attack the other clusters one at a time.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: Re-green baseline tests so structural review can begin. n/a architectural test (build failure, not refactor).
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Speculatively rewrite slices, change RTK middleware list, upgrade dependencies as part of this loop, or refactor any production code outside store.ts.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: Existing packages/state/test/tierSlice.test.ts (already passing) plus any state suites that were compile-blocked become test surface for next loop.

backlog.title: Restore type-checked compile in packages/state/src/store.ts
backlog.why_it_matters: Cascades into 2 state test suites; without it, RTK-level state ownership cannot be reviewed.
backlog.score_impact: Restores measurability for state management, data flow, framework idioms, test strategy.

builder_notes.pattern: Test suite drift after framework upgrade
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: TS type errors in store.ts paired with runtime field-not-found errors in slice tests
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When bumping @reduxjs/toolkit, re-run all workspace tests and treat any new TS error as part of the upgrade scope, not 'we'll fix it later'
builder_notes.stack_example: RTK 2.x tightened Reducer generic and Tuple middleware typing; the same code that worked under 1.x trips strict checks now.

builder_notes.pattern: Test asserting an exact field that has been deleted from production state
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Property 'totalComparisons' does not exist on type 'HeadToHeadState' in a test file
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Slice tests assert through actions, not against private state shape; if you remove a field, the test is the canonical place to discover its loss before main
builder_notes.stack_example: RTK createSlice — test reducers via dispatched actions, not direct state-key reads.

builder_notes.pattern: Bundler-aware ESM in node_modules running through Jest's default CJS transform
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token at import inside a .cjs file in a vendor package
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Configure Jest transformIgnorePatterns to allow ESM-shipping vendor packages through ts-jest/babel, or migrate that test layer to Vitest
builder_notes.stack_example: @react-spectrum/s2 ships dual .cjs/.mjs but the .cjs file uses ESM import — Jest needs an explicit transform exemption.

loops.narrative: Miss this loop. Codebase is on a redesign branch; test suite has not kept up with implementation across three packages. Structural review blocked. Smallest honest first step is restoring packages/state/src/store.ts to a clean TypeScript compile so the state-package suite can re-run; that unblocks RTK-level review of the largest mutable runtime concern. Other failure clusters (core analytics/CSV/sorting, ui ESM transform) are real but isolated and queued for subsequent loops.

loop_result.what_changed: Wrapped packages/state/src/store.ts reducer map in combineReducers and derived RootState from ReturnType<typeof rootReducer>; switched packages/state/src/persistenceMiddleware.ts to untyped Middleware with an `as RootState` cast at use to break the circular type dependency.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: npx tsc --noEmit in packages/state reports 0 errors at store.ts or persistenceMiddleware.ts post-edit (was 5 errors pre-edit: TS2322 at lines 32/34/35, TS2719 at line 40, and earlier 2502 in persistenceMiddleware); remaining 4 errors live in selectors.ts and core/bundled/index.ts and are explicitly out of F1's blast_radius. importJSON.test.ts now compiles where it previously could not.

implementation_review.reason: The combineReducers wrapper and Middleware cast correctly resolve the RTK 2.x Reducer generic mismatch (TS2322) and the circular-type-dependency in persistenceMiddleware.ts; the targeted compile cluster is fixed using canonical RTK 2.x idioms with no new structural smells.
